notices.html: Book ahead for Bellemont Farm's Sunflower Festival: advance online tickets ($19 adult, $12 kids) are cheaper than at the door ($25, $15), and the festival runs weekends through mid-September if this one's booked up.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: blackberries continue pick-your-own, along with green beans, peppers and tomatoes. Still no peaches this year, the spring freeze wiped out the crop. Store and donuts open 9 to 6, no pets; call 609-924-2310 to confirm the day's picking.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed 2026 update posted online for this small, diversified farm, but the u-pick season runs June through October, and August typically brings blackberries, corn, tomatoes, cantaloupe and peppers. Call 609-448-0629 to confirm the day's picking and hours before you go.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: blackberries are pick-your-own at the Monmouth Junction fields ($3 field admission plus a container fee), blueberries have wrapped for the season, and apples won't ripen until mid-September. Von Thun's Sunflower Trail is at their Washington Township farm in Warren County, not here, so call 732-329-8656 to confirm what's ready to pick at Monmouth Junction.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: Emery's blueberry season has wound down. Sunflowers are grown here but sold bunched at the farm market rather than pick-your-own. Call 609-758-8514 to check what's out before you drive over.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: the spring freeze wiped out cherries, peaches, nectarines and apples this year, so there's no pick-your-own fruit at Battleview right now. The bakery and farm store stay open for cider donuts and baked goods; call 732-462-0756 to confirm what's on hand.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: blackberries are newly added for 2026 alongside late-summer tomatoes, zucchini and zinnias. The ticketed Evening Sunflower Strolls ran the first two weekends of August and have wrapped, so call the Pick Your Own Hotline 609-654-5894 to confirm what's ready before you go.

events.title: Bellemont Farm Sunflower Festival
events.note: $19 adult, $12 kids 3-12 in advance (more at the door), under 3 free
events.desc: Acres of blooming sunflowers to stroll and cut your own bouquet from, plus food trucks, craft activities and a kids' play area, opening weekend of a run through mid-September.

events.title: Canning Day and Pickling
events.place: Howell Living History Farm, Hopewell Township
events.desc: A hands-on look at how farm families preserved summer produce before refrigeration, with kids welcome to help can and pickle the day's harvest.

events.title: Summer Reading Wrap-Up Celebration
events.desc: A dance party finale for Summer Reading 2026 with DJ James Myricks, a fun free wind-down before school starts back up.

events.title: Feelin' Stronger Every Day
events.desc: A free community wellness afternoon with a 16-piece tribute band covering Chicago's greatest hits, local wellness activities, and a closing dance party.

events.title: Disney's Aladdin KIDS, final performances
events.desc: Last chance to catch this high-energy 40-minute kid-cast musical version of Aladdin, an easy pairing with the Bellemont sunflower fields just down the road in Lambertville.
